PROGRESS NOTE

Reason for Visit: Annual surveillance following bioprosthetic aortic valve replacement.

The patient denies chest pain, dyspnea, presyncope, or syncope since the last visit.
Physical examination is notable for a soft systolic ejection murmur, unchanged from prior.

Echocardiographic Findings: The effective orifice area (EOA) is 1.6 cm2, and the
dimensionless valve index is 0.51. The mean gradient is 12 mmHg. These findings are
consistent with normally functioning prosthetic valve, with no significant interval change
from the reference study obtained shortly after implantation.

Assessment: Normally functioning surgical bioprosthesis, no evidence of structural valve
deterioration at this time.

Plan: Continue routine annual surveillance echocardiography.
